subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Western Grammar School team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, checking work against them and keeping site and progress records.

Your role mixes drafting with coordinating contractors, consultants and council on the school's building program, and that mix of office and site is what I want. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial drafting, so I would start at junior level. I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.greeting: Dear Western Grammar School Hiring Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK. The role combines preparing and revising drawings with coordinating contractors, consultants and council, and that is the start I want in civil drafting.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared quantities and cost estimates, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day and checked work against the drawings. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I kept site reports, material records and progress reports.

I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, an Australian driver's licence and a White Card. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My CAD experience is from study rather than commercial drafting, so I would start at junior level and learn your project standards quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
